title: Recent Advances in Optimal Transport for Machine Learning
tldr_zh: 2012–2023 OT×ML 应用全景综述，按监督/无监督/迁移/强化四块组织，附计算 OT 五类进展与复杂度对照表
tldr_en: TPAMI survey of OT for ML 2012-2023 across supervised, unsupervised, transfer and RL, plus computational OT extensions (sliced, low-rank, neural, minibatch, unbalanced) with a complexity table.
key_numbers: Table 1: plug-in W_p sample complexity O(n^{-1/d}), time O(n^3 log n); Sinkhorn divergence O(n^{-1/2}(1+eps^{-floor(d/2)})), O(n^2) per iteration; sliced W_p O(n^{-1/2}), O(n log n); MBOT O(n^{-1/2}), O(k m^3 log m) (Sec. 8.1)
Fig. 15: empirical W_2 between two samples of U([0,1]^d) stays far from 0 at d=100 for n up to 10^3, SW_2 insensitive to d (Sec. 8.1)
Fig. 5: minibatch OT plans with m=2,10,100 become less sparse as m shrinks (Sec. 3.4)
